thread_title: New Player wanting to understand how to efficiently use a team

content:
Corposant: Generates cards called “Pilots” from her 4 cost and 2 cost. Triggering the aftershock effect of the pilots gives you strength and tentacle damage, letting you rapidly scale the more you accumulate overtime. Her strike/defense also benefit from aftershock effects. Additionally, her 4 cost lowers its arithmetica cost and returns to your hand every time you discard it, letting you eventually play it for 0 arithmetica. Her exalt lets you discard your entire hand while providing shield (and vulnerable at E3).

Aurita: Her 2 cost lets her discard your hand while her 0 cost lets you deal damage and create multiple copies of the card with aftershock effects.

Casiah: Provides ultra space, card draw, and lets you discard cards with her 1 cost. She can create copies of cards by bringing them back from the ultra space too.

Pontos: Changes Aequor to divine Aequor which is in general stronger than normal Aequor. His gaunts have aftershock which will lower their cost. He also scales and becomes stronger over a longer exploration since he has more chances to generate more permanent gaunts every time you kill an enemy with his exalt.

thread_title: Where to Spend My Pulls?

content:
1. If you could only pull 1 character, most people would still say Mouchette as she is the strongest DPS in the game. Minimum enlightenment is E2 and E3 lets her consistently clear DZone A5 (hardest endgame mode difficulty) consistently with good support. 

2. If you can, get Saya too. She is very very strong support who can let subpar DPSs clear A5. Additionally, her wheel is very strong on any team (think of how strong 1 extra mana from the start in a card game with resources).

3. Glotan is a strong character and will be good to have, but I personally believe Mouchette would still take priority. Keep in mind, endgame needs multiple invested teams, so you do want to eventually get multiple DPS units.

4. All of those characters can serve as foundations on their own teams. Again, it’s up to you if you want to pull and invest into them. 

Idrk how many pulls you have, so it’s harder to make judgements on how much you wanna spend. More information could help in people giving advice
